checks.conclusion: The synchronous offset publication rechecks the binding closed predicate inside the Root subject commit, before UI mutation. The queued-close race is covered by the existing final 33-check proof.
Every asynchronous launch captures its actual coroutine context and checks caller cancellation, binding openness, and logical source ownership before IO and again inside UI/private-context commit.
Early retry/search/select/offset cannot borrow an old query or cache key while a new source load is queued. The last lease/key/query are published together under current request admission.
A child SupervisorJob tracks original launched jobs. Close cancels them, joins outside the publication gate, and returns false on timeout until blocking IO actually drains.

Only original MusicViewModel lyrics declarations are selected, with indexed reverse replay. The supplied existing LyricsRepository, original FileLyricsCache/schema, native playback and public transport retain sole owners.
